svg.title: A-301 Third Floor Apartment — Enlarged Plan
svg.text: External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Enlarged from A-103. The party wall can only be opened
between y 3.80 and 7.18, so the living, dining and kitchen
occupy that whole band as one 10.60 m wide room and form
the only link between the two blocks.
2. Bedroom 1 and its ensuite take block B, windowed on the
open east boundary. The ensuite is entered from the
dressing room, and the dressing room from bedroom 1.
3. Block A carries the entry hall on the front door, with the
guest WC, the store, the family bath and its passage off
it, and bedroom 2 beyond — 18.0 m² across the whole north
end, with two windows in the north wall.
4. No room on this floor is entered through another.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P2 2026-09-24 east windows, taller floors, garden on A-100
P3 2026-09-29 four storeys, apartments, straight north boundary
P4 2026-09-29 north and east opened up, light court removed
